high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "kalyanipriyadarshan." The post was made 3 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The location is marked as Oxford, as indicated by the pin icon with the word "Oxford" next to it. The main focus of the image is a large, historic building with a Gothic architectural style. The building features multiple stories, pointed arch windows, and decorative elements typical of Gothic design. The facade is adorned with ivy, which adds a touch of greenery and contrasts with the stone structure.
